title: Normalized coefficient-linear evaluation of localized strict tensor descent
statement: Use the normalized strict tensor reduction-family and representative comparison data [def-sf-localized-strict-tensor-comparison-data]. Given presentations on a site and its slice, a strict coefficient tower S, a positive level n, an ordinary projection comparison eta and a derived comparison rho, define a coefficient-linear evaluation presentation to consist of: canonically normalized base and slice evaluation models; an ordinary scalar-restriction/extension comparison fixed by the identity on extension generators; an S_n-linear ordinary projection iso whose scalar restriction is the component of eta; an S_n-linear derived projection iso fixed on every flat-term K-flat representative by its ordinary chain iso and the universal scalar-extension counits; and the equation identifying exact evaluation of rho with scalar restriction of this iso under the specified evaluation and extension comparisons. This is a record of the data and equations, with existence asserted separately.
